get_consumed_primary_input.sql: SELECT i.*, b.provider AS batch_provider, r.result_id AS paid_id, r.provider AS paid_provider, r.batch_id AS paid_batch, r.custom_id AS paid_custom, r.term AS paid_term, r.number AS paid_number, r.result_json AS paid_json, a.application_json AS projection_json FROM llm_batch_items i JOIN llm_batches b ON b.batch_id=i.batch_id LEFT JOIN computation_results r ON r.provider=? AND r.batch_id=i.batch_id AND r.custom_id=i.custom_id LEFT JOIN result_applications a ON a.result_id=r.result_id AND a.term=r.term AND a.number=r.number AND a.generation=? AND a.phase='projection' WHERE i.batch_id=? AND i.custom_id=? AND i.consumed_at IS NOT NULL
details: SEARCH i USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_llm_batch_items_1 (batch_id=? AND custom_id=?)
SEARCH r USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_computation_results_2 (provider=? AND batch_id=? AND custom_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH a USING INDEX ux_result_application_generation (result_id=? AND term=? AND number=? AND generation=? AND phase=?) LEFT-JOIN

source_observations_for_selection.sql: SELECT * FROM source_observations INDEXED BY ix_source_observations_selection WHERE selection_id=? AND term=? AND number=? AND purpose='analysis' ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 2
